title.value: Improving Passage Retrieval with Zero-Shot Question Generation
title.justification: The paper focuses on enhancing the retrieval of passages using zero-shot question generation techniques as part of question answering systems.
title.quote: Improving Passage Retrieval with Zero-Shot Question Generation

extractions.description: The paper introduces a novel re-ranking method for passage retrieval in open-domain question answering. By utilizing zero-shot question generation, the re-ranker re-scores passages using a pre-trained language model that computes the likelihood of an input question conditioned on a retrieved passage. This approach improves retrieval accuracy significantly without any task-specific training, enhancing both unsupervised and supervised models.

primary_category.justification: The focus of the paper is on improving text retrieval using NLP and language models rather than any direct eco-responsible application or theme. The main theme revolves around techniques in Natural Language Processing for question answering, which do not align directly with eco-responsible AI topics.
primary_category.quote: We propose a simple and effective re-ranking method for improving passage retrieval in open question answering.

secondary_categories.quote: We focus on open-domain question answering and introduce a re-ranker based on zero-shot question generation with a pre-trained language model.
